test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**the**" is a definite article used before singular and plural nouns when the noun is specific or particular.
 
• In the context of the sentence, "the" is used to specify the small amount of water the camel has in its body.
 
• The other options: "**very**," "**a**," and "**which**" do not fit grammatically or contextually in this sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *When a camel cannot find water, it passes less urine to conserve the__ small amount of water it has in its body.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **very:** An adverb that describes the extent or degree of something, but does not fit the context here.
 
• **a:** An indefinite article used before singular countable nouns when the noun is not specific. It doesn't fit in this context of referring to a specific amount of water.
 
• **which:** A relative pronoun that introduces information about the noun preceding it, which doesn't fit this sentence structure.
